comment:
* Helper for accessing features in {@link AccessibilityEvent}
 * introduced after API level 4 in a backwards compatible fashion.

variables.name: TYPE_VIEW_HOVER_ENTER
variables.comment: * Represents the event of a hover enter over a {@link android.view.View}.

variables.name: TYPE_VIEW_HOVER_EXIT
variables.comment: * Represents the event of a hover exit over a {@link android.view.View}.

variables.name: TYPE_TOUCH_EXPLORATION_GESTURE_START
variables.comment: * Represents the event of starting a touch exploration gesture.

variables.name: TYPE_TOUCH_EXPLORATION_GESTURE_END
variables.comment: * Represents the event of ending a touch exploration gesture.

variables.name: TYPE_WINDOW_CONTENT_CHANGED
variables.comment: * Represents the event of changing the content of a window.

variables.name: TYPE_VIEW_SCROLLED
variables.comment: * Represents the event of scrolling a view.

variables.name: TYPE_VIEW_TEXT_SELECTION_CHANGED
variables.comment: * Represents the event of changing the selection in an {@link android.widget.EditText}.

variables.name: TYPE_ANNOUNCEMENT
variables.comment: * Represents the event of an application making an announcement.

variables.name: TYPE_VIEW_ACCESSIBILITY_FOCUSED
variables.comment: * Represents the event of gaining accessibility focus.

variables.name: TYPE_VIEW_ACCESSIBILITY_FOCUS_CLEARED
variables.comment: * Represents the event of clearing accessibility focus.

variables.name: TYPE_VIEW_TEXT_TRAVERSED_AT_MOVEMENT_GRANULARITY
variables.comment: * Represents the event of traversing the text of a view at a given movement granularity.

variables.name: TYPE_GESTURE_DETECTION_START
variables.comment: * Represents the event of beginning gesture detection.

variables.name: TYPE_GESTURE_DETECTION_END
variables.comment: * Represents the event of ending gesture detection.

variables.name: TYPE_TOUCH_INTERACTION_START
variables.comment: * Represents the event of the user starting to touch the screen.

variables.name: TYPE_TOUCH_INTERACTION_END
variables.comment: * Represents the event of the user ending to touch the screen.

variables.name: CONTENT_CHANGE_TYPE_UNDEFINED
variables.comment:
* Change type for {@link #TYPE_WINDOW_CONTENT_CHANGED} event:
     * The type of change is not defined.

variables.name: CONTENT_CHANGE_TYPE_SUBTREE
variables.comment:
* Change type for {@link #TYPE_WINDOW_CONTENT_CHANGED} event:
     * A node in the subtree rooted at the source node was added or removed.

variables.name: CONTENT_CHANGE_TYPE_TEXT
variables.comment:
* Change type for {@link #TYPE_WINDOW_CONTENT_CHANGED} event:
     * The node's text changed.

variables.name: CONTENT_CHANGE_TYPE_CONTENT_DESCRIPTION
variables.comment:
* Change type for {@link #TYPE_WINDOW_CONTENT_CHANGED} event:
     * The node's content description changed.

variables.name: TYPES_ALL_MASK
variables.comment:
* Mask for {@link AccessibilityEvent} all types.
     *
     * @see AccessibilityEvent#TYPE_VIEW_CLICKED
     * @see AccessibilityEvent#TYPE_VIEW_LONG_CLICKED
     * @see AccessibilityEvent#TYPE_VIEW_SELECTED
     * @see AccessibilityEvent#TYPE_VIEW_FOCUSED
     * @see AccessibilityEvent#TYPE_VIEW_TEXT_CHANGED
     * @see AccessibilityEvent#TYPE_WINDOW_STATE_CHANGED
     * @see AccessibilityEvent#TYPE_NOTIFICATION_STATE_CHANGED
     * @see #TYPE_VIEW_HOVER_ENTER
     * @see #TYPE_VIEW_HOVER_EXIT
     * @see #TYPE_TOUCH_EXPLORATION_GESTURE_START
     * @see #TYPE_TOUCH_EXPLORATION_GESTURE_END
     * @see #TYPE_WINDOW_CONTENT_CHANGED
     * @see #TYPE_VIEW_SCROLLED
     * @see #TYPE_VIEW_TEXT_SELECTION_CHANGED
     * @see #TYPE_ANNOUNCEMENT
     * @see #TYPE_VIEW_TEXT_TRAVERSED_AT_MOVEMENT_GRANULARITY
     * @see #TYPE_GESTURE_DETECTION_START
     * @see #TYPE_GESTURE_DETECTION_END
     * @see #TYPE_TOUCH_INTERACTION_START
     * @see #TYPE_TOUCH_INTERACTION_END

methods.name: public static int getRecordCount(AccessibilityEvent event)
methods.comment:
* Gets the number of records contained in the event.
     *
     * @return The number of records.

methods.name: public static void appendRecord(AccessibilityEvent event, AccessibilityRecordCompat record)
methods.comment:
* Appends an {@link android.view.accessibility.AccessibilityRecord} to the end of
     * event records.
     *
     * @param record The record to append.
     *
     * @throws IllegalStateException If called from an AccessibilityService.

methods.name: public static AccessibilityRecordCompat getRecord(AccessibilityEvent event, int index)
methods.comment:
* Gets the record at a given index.
     *
     * @param index The index.
     * @return The record at the specified index.

methods.name: public static AccessibilityRecordCompat asRecord(AccessibilityEvent event)
methods.comment:
* Creates an {@link AccessibilityRecordCompat} from an {@link AccessibilityEvent} * that can be used to manipulate the event properties defined in * {@link android.view.accessibility.AccessibilityRecord}. *

* Note: Do not call {@link AccessibilityRecordCompat#recycle()} on the * returned {@link AccessibilityRecordCompat}. Call {@link AccessibilityEvent#recycle()} * in case you want to recycle the event. *

* * @param event The from which to create a record. * @return An {@link AccessibilityRecordCompat}.

methods.name: public static void setContentChangeTypes(AccessibilityEvent event, int changeTypes)
methods.comment:
* Sets the bit mask of node tree changes signaled by an
     * {@link #TYPE_WINDOW_CONTENT_CHANGED} event.
     *
     * @param changeTypes The bit mask of change types.
     * @throws IllegalStateException If called from an AccessibilityService.
     * @see #getContentChangeTypes(AccessibilityEvent)

methods.name: public static int getContentChangeTypes(AccessibilityEvent event)

methodNames: public static void appendRecord(AccessibilityEvent event, AccessibilityRecordCompat record)
public static AccessibilityRecordCompat getRecord(AccessibilityEvent event, int index)
public static void setContentChangeTypes(AccessibilityEvent event, int changeTypes)
